messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] RHIPE installation problem
parts:
Followed the below to install RHIPE

Installation of R:

hduser@master$wget http://cran.r-project.org/src/base/R-2/R-2.15.1.tar.gz #downloaded the file in the home/hduser
hduser@master$tar -xzf R-2.15.1.tar.gz
hduser@master$cd R-2.15.1
hduser@master-R-2.15.1$./configure --enable-R-shlib --with-x=no
hduser@master-R-2.15.1$make
hduser@master-R-2.15.1$make install
1. Is this the correct way to install R and if yes, the above installation installs all the packages available?

Yes, it installs base and recommended

 
2. Does the R version which I have downloaded will support RHIPE?


I am using 2.15

 
Installation of Protocall buffers:

hduser@master$wget http://protobuf.googlecode.com/files/protobuf-2.4.1.tar.gz
hduser@master$tar -xzf protobuf-2.4.1.tar.gz
hduser@master$cd protobuf-2.4.1
hdu...@master-protobuf-2.4.1$./configure
hdu...@master-protobuf-2.4.1$make
hdu...@master-protobuf-2.4.1$make install
1. Does the protobuf version support RHIPE?


Yes
If the above two are installed properly

1.How to create the environment variables PKG_CONFIG_PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH and should I create any other environment variables?


You might or not might need eitther, depending on how your installation is. However mine looks like

export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PKG_CONFIG_PATH:$PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib/:$PREFIX/lib64:$PREFIX/lib64//R/lib:/usr/java/jdk1.6.0_26/jre/lib/amd64/server/


PREFIX is my custom installation directory

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] RHIPE installation problem
parts:
For creating env variable, you can create in your .bashrc profile and if you want it for current session (terminal) you can use export..
 
More over the rhipe installation fails if there is stale cache..so try to run ldconfig to remove stale cache...
Please have a look in Bangalore R users groups where i ehave mentioned what could be the possible erros while installing RHipe..
 
Regards,
Som
